---
title: "Export"
---

<div id="selected-list"></div>

<button id="download-exam" type="button">Download exam</button>
<button id="clear-exam" type="button">Clear selection</button>

<pre id="status" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></pre>


<script>
/*
  Export-page script (Tier 1)
  - Reuses getSelectedItems() from assets/exam-select.js
  - Fetches /items/markdown/<item_id>.md
  - Extracts sections headed by "### Question" and "### Answer"
  - Downloads a single exam.txt with an answer key
*/

// --- Utilities ---

function rawUrlFor(itemId) {
  // If your site is hosted under a subpath, you may need a relative path like "../items/markdown/..."
  // return `/items/markdown/${itemId}.md`;
  return `items/markdown/${itemId}.md`;
}

function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s)
    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;");
}

// Extract the content under a heading like:
// ### Question
// ...text...
// ### Answer
function extractSection(md, headingText) {
  // match heading line and capture until next "### " heading or end-of-file
  const re = new RegExp(
    `(^|\\n)###\\s+${headingText}\\s*\\n([\\s\\S]*?)(?=\\n###\\s+|$)`,
    "i"
  );
  const m = md.match(re);
  return m ? m[2].trim() : "";
}

function downloadText(filename, text) {
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

function setStatus(msg) {
  const el = document.getElementById("status");
  if (el) el.textContent = msg;
}

function appendStatus(msg) {
  const el = document.getElementById("status");
  if (el) el.textContent += msg;
}

// --- UI rendering ---

function renderSelectedList(ids) {
  const el = document.getElementById("selected-list");
  if (!el) return;

  if (!ids || ids.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = "<p><em>No items selected.</em></p>";
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML =
    "<p><strong>Selected items:</strong></p>" +
    "<ul>" +
    ids.map(id => `<li>${escapeHtml(id)}</li>`).join("") +
    "</ul>";
}

// --- Main export logic ---

async function fetchItemRaw(id) {
  const url = rawUrlFor(id);
  const resp = await fetch(url);

  if (!resp.ok) {
    return { id, ok: false, url, error: `HTTP ${resp.status}` };
  }

  const md = await resp.text();

  const question = extractSection(md, "Question");
  const answer   = extractSection(md, "Correct Answer");

  return { id, ok: true, url, question, answer };
}

function buildExamText(itemsOk) {
  let out = "";

  // Questions section
  itemsOk.forEach((it, i) => {
    const n = i + 1;
    const q = it.question && it.question.length ? it.question : "[Missing Question]";
    out += `${n}. ${q}\n\n`;
  });

  out += "----------------------------------\n";
  out += "Answer Key\n\n";

  // Answer key
  itemsOk.forEach((it, i) => {
    const n = i + 1;
    const a = it.answer && it.answer.length ? it.answer : "[Missing Answer]";
    out += `${n}. ${a}\n`;
  });

  return out;
}

async function handleDownloadClick() {
  // getSelectedItems() must exist in exam-select.js
  if (typeof getSelectedItems !== "function") {
    setStatus("Error: getSelectedItems() not found. Make sure /assets/exam-select.js is included on this page.");
    return;
  }

  const ids = getSelectedItems();

  if (!ids || ids.length === 0) {
    setStatus("No items selected.");
    return;
  }

  setStatus(`Fetching ${ids.length} item(s)...\n`);

  // Fetch all in parallel (preserves ordering of ids)
  const results = await Promise.all(ids.map(fetchItemRaw));

  const failed = results.filter(r => !r.ok);
  const ok = results.filter(r => r.ok);

  if (failed.length) {
    appendStatus("Some items could not be fetched:\n");
    failed.forEach(f => appendStatus(`- ${f.id} (${f.url}): ${f.error}\n`));
    appendStatus("\n");
  }

  if (!ok.length) {
    appendStatus("No items could be exported.");
    return;
  }

  // Warnings for missing sections
  const missingQ = ok.filter(r => !r.question);
  const missingA = ok.filter(r => !r.answer);

  if (missingQ.length) {
    appendStatus("Warning: missing '### Question' section in:\n");
    missingQ.forEach(r => appendStatus(`- ${r.id}\n`));
    appendStatus("\n");
  }
  if (missingA.length) {
    appendStatus("Warning: missing '### Answer' section in:\n");
    missingA.forEach(r => appendStatus(`- ${r.id}\n`));
    appendStatus("\n");
  }

  const text = buildExamText(ok);

  downloadText("exam.txt", text);

  appendStatus("Downloaded exam.txt\n");
}

function handleClearClick() {
  // Clear selection using the same key exam-select.js uses.
  // If exam-select.js already provides a clear function, you can call it instead.
  localStorage.removeItem("selected_items");

  renderSelectedList([]);
  setStatus("Selection cleared.");
}

// --- Wire up page ---

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const ids = (typeof getSelectedItems === "function") ? getSelectedItems() : [];
  renderSelectedList(ids);

  const btnDownload = document.getElementById("download-exam");
  if (btnDownload) btnDownload.addEventListener("click", handleDownloadClick);

  const btnClear = document.getElementById("clear-exam");
  if (btnClear) btnClear.addEventListener("click", handleClearClick);

  // If the helper isn't loaded, show a helpful message
  if (typeof getSelectedItems !== "function") {
    setStatus("Note: getSelectedItems() not found yet. Ensure /assets/exam-select.js is included site-wide.");
  }
});
</script>
